1.web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.
1.asv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.

2.web: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.
2.asv: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.

3.web: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
3.asv: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

4.web: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
4.asv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.

5.web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;
5.asv: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:

6.web: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;
6.asv: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;

7.web: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
7.asv: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.

8.web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
8.asv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

9.web: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
9.asv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.

10.web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
10.asv: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.

11.web: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
11.asv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.

12.web: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
12.asv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.

13.web: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
13.asv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.
